evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in slow-running queries.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Query optimization and reliability language balances against 'ad-hoc analytical questions' and business-responsiveness framing, giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: focusing on solutions targeting the real estate and engineering industry
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect internal BI reporting for a real estate/engineering MNC without regulatory or financial-reporting language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing traditional SQL Server BI stack (SSIS/SSRS) is being modernized toward Azure cloud services, indicating an established but evolving data function rather than a from-zero build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Leverage Microsoft Azure cloud services (such as Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, or Azure Synapse) to modernize and scale our BI infrastructure.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise tools (Power BI/DAX/Power Query, SSIS, SSRS, Azure Data Factory/Synapse) showing exactly what the role does day to day, though it's a recruiter-mediated posting rather than one written directly by the hiring manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Act as a data partner to the business. Answer ad-hoc analytical questions, identify data trends, and help stakeholders understand the "why" behind the metrics.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves 'the business' broadly through BI reporting and dashboards rather than one specific commercial, product, or finance function, an internal-data orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: All responsibilities are scoped execution verbs (manage, design, develop, maintain, write, troubleshoot, optimize, answer) responding to defined BI/reporting needs rather than setting new strategic direction.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Absent — no testing, data quality, or data contract language appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD focuses on BI development, ETL, and query optimization rather than any explicit data testing or quality framework.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in delivery and capability terms (BI lifecycle, dashboards, query optimization) with no risk, compliance, or reliability register present.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Experience migrating legacy on-premise SSIS/SSRS workloads into Azure native services
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by maintain/modernize verbs applied to an existing traditional BI stack (SSIS/SSRS) being migrated to Azure, indicating fix/scale.
